• Runs use the Real Time Attack (RTA) timing convention, which means it measures the real time that has passed from start to finish, rather than in-game time. Runs may be timed with an external timer (such as LiveSplit), though the timer DOES NOT have to be shown on video.

**Runs require video evidence. The video must show:**

• The entire duration of the run from start to finish (breaks for stream drops are excusable if minor) without edits or cuts.

**Additionally:**

• Game must be restarted before each (full or misc) run. The video must show [initial load of the game.](https://i.imgur.com/fgwlv6Z.png)

• Any save files loaded must be made during the run.

• The [Frame Limiter in the options](http://i.imgur.com/oa8pk15.png) is allowed to switched on and off as per the runner's wishes.

• 3rd party frame limiters **are allowed**.

• All modifications besides the ones listed here (https://www.speedrun.com/gtasa/thread/ar4sg) are banned.

• Using OS functions to affect the game in an unintended way during the run is prohibited.

• Cheats (including accidental) are banned.
